The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1989–90 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] won the championship.

==Promotion/relegation play-offs==
Starting this season, the number 16 of the Eredivisie would play against relegation against the runners-up of the [[1989–90 Eerste Divisie#Promotion/relegation play-offs|promotion/relegation play-offs]] of the [[Eerste Divisie]]. The Eerste Divisie league champions and winner of the play-offs would replace the numbers 17 and 18 of this league directly. See [[1989–90 Eerste Divisie#New play-off system|here]] for details of the system.

{{TwoLegStart}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Emmen|Emmen]]||1-2|'''[[NEC Nijmegen|NEC]]'''||1-2|0-0}}
{{end}}

NEC: remain in Eredivisie <br>
Emmen: remain in Eerste Divisie
